questions.text: Which of the following is closest in meaning to "locked up" in paragraph 2?
questions.explanation: In this context, "locked up" means that the fresh water is confined or limited within polar ice caps and glaciers, making it unavailable for immediate use.

questions.text: According to the passage, which of the following best describes the word "urge" in paragraph 4?
questions.explanation: An "urge" is a strong, persistent desire or impulse to do something.

questions.text: Which of the following has the same meaning as the word "exceed" in paragraph 5?
questions.explanation: "Exceed" means to go beyond a set limit, number, or amount.

questions.text: What does Charakasamhita mean when saying "Diseases are a sign of the cleansing and healing effect of nature" in paragraph 4?
options: Your body has its own way to heal from the disease.
Nature may heal diseases that you suffer from.
Nature contributes a lot to the diseases that you may have.
When you are sick, your body is cleaning itself.
questions.correctAnswer: When you are sick, your body is cleaning itself.
questions.explanation: The statement implies that illness is a natural process through which the body cleanses and heals itself.

questions.text: The word "stroll" in paragraph 2 is closest in meaning to which of the following?
questions.explanation: A "stroll" is a slow, relaxed, and unhurried walk.

questions.text: What does the author mean by "But in reality, it is less spa town and more boot camp" in paragraph 2?
options: The institute applies a tight rule for the patients.
The institute is run by military staff.
The institute only treats military officers.
The institute is a relaxing center.
The institute combines a relaxing center and a camping area.
questions.correctAnswer: The institute applies a tight rule for the patients.
questions.explanation: Comparing the institute to a "boot camp" indicates that it has strict discipline, rigorous routines, and tight rules rather than being a purely relaxing spa.

questions.text: From the term "a state of emergency" in paragraph 1, it can be inferred that it refers to a state where ...
options: Cross-borders copy-right rules cannot be overcome
WIPO members are unable to come up with a solution
The blinds are kept in the dark
questions.correctAnswer: WIPO members are unable to come up with a solution
questions.explanation: The term is used to highlight a critical situation where immediate action is required because negotiators have failed to reach a timely agreement.

questions.text: It can be inferred from passage that the word "light" in the phrase "hope and light" in paragraph 1 refers to ....
questions.explanation: Since the speech is addressed to helping blind people, "light" metaphorically represents vision or the ability to see and perceive the world.
